title: Turn off Game DVR background recording (Game Bar clips)
description: Sets the documented group policy value AllowGameDVR to 0 under HKLM Software Policies Microsoft Windows GameDVR and the documented user value GameDVR_Enabled to 0 under HKCU System GameConfigStore. Background game recording stops; manual Game Bar recording is disabled while the policy is applied. The previous values and their types are captured in a snapshot before the change and restored by per-feature undo.
